source_name.description: The iSCSI qualified source name of the server. If empty, derived from hostname.

database_path.description: Absolute path to the directory where the iSNS database is stored. If empty, kept in memory.

registration_period.description: Period of inactivity after which registered entities are purged. '0' disables this.

default_discovery_domain.description: If 1, creates a virtual default discovery domain holding all nodes not in an admin-configured domain.

slp_register.description: If 1, register the iSNS server with SLP for service discovery.

client_key_store.description: Location of the client key store. 'DB:' uses the iSNS database, otherwise a path to a flat directory.

scn_timeout.description: Time in seconds to wait for an ACK on State Change Notifications before retransmitting.

scn_retries.description: Number of retransmission attempts for State Change Notifications if ACK is not received.

esi_min_interval.description: Minimum interval for ESI (Endpoint Status Indication) checks.

esi_max_interval.description: Maximum interval for ESI (Endpoint Status Indication) checks.

esi_retries.description: Number of retries for ESI checks. 0 disables ESI support.

auth_replay_window.description: Time window for verifying authentication timestamps to prevent replay attacks.

auth_timestamp_jitter.description: Amount of jitter added to authentication timestamps to prevent replay attacks.
